idea-plugin.name: Easy Notes
idea-plugin.description:
Easy Notes is the Powerful, distraction-free notepad that lives right inside your IDE. Capture ideas, TODOs, snippets, and meeting notes on a warm, ruled legal-pad editor — no context switching, no lost sticky notes, nothing to set up. Just open the tool window and start writing.

Every keystroke is saved automatically and kept globally across every project and every restart, so your notes are always exactly where you left them. Easy Notes even reopens the last note you were reading when you relaunch your IDE.

  

✨ Everything you need to stay organized

  • 📝 Effortless auto-save — type freely; every note persists globally across IDE sessions, projects, and restarts.
  • 🖋️ Your font, your way — choose the font family and size for all your notes, with a live preview; defaults to your IDE font until you change it.
  • 🗂️ All notes in one place — a clean, searchable list with a single-click, single-window editor.
  • 🔎 Instant search — filter notes by title or content as you type.
  • ↕️ Smart sorting — order notes by title, creation date, or last modified.
  • 🎨 Color-code everything — give each note its own background color from a palette or a custom picker.
  • 📌 Pin & ⭐ star — keep important notes on top and mark your favorites, with a favorites-only filter.
  • ⚡ Keyboard-first — create, delete, search, and jump between notes without touching the mouse.
  • 🧭 Fast navigation — flip through notes with previous/next controls.
  • 🗑️ Safe, reversible deletes — remove one, several, or all notes — with one-click Undo.
  • 🔁 Own your data — import and export as JSON or Markdown with smart conflict handling.
  • 🌗 Looks great everywhere — automatic light and dark theme support.

⌨️ Keyboard shortcuts

All shortcuts are active only while the Easy Notes tool window is focused, so they never conflict with the rest of your IDE keymap:

  • New note — Cmd+N (macOS) / Ctrl+N
  • Search notes — Cmd+F (macOS) / Ctrl+F
  • Open selected note — Enter (in the list)
  • Delete selected note(s) — Delete or Backspace (in the list)
  • Previous / next note — Alt+Up / Alt+Down (while a note is open)
  • Back to list — Esc (while a note is open)

Prefer your own bindings? Every toolbar action can be remapped under Settings → Keymap → Plug-ins → Easy Notes.

Lightweight & dependency-free — a tiny plugin with zero bundled third-party libraries, so it stays fast and out of your way.

🔒 Private by design — every note is stored locally in your IDE's configuration directory. Nothing is uploaded, tracked, or sent anywhere; your notes never leave your machine unless you export them yourself.

Works in all IntelliJ-based IDEs: IntelliJ IDEA, Android Studio, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, PhpStorm, Rider, CLion, and more.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.1

  • 📌 Reopens the last note you were viewing after an IDE restart (falls back to the list on first run, or if that note was deleted).
  • Previous / next navigation is remembered too, so you land on the exact note you left, not only the one you originally clicked.

1.0.0 — Initial release 🎉

  • 📝 Ruled legal-pad note editor with automatic saving and global persistence.
  • 🗂️ Searchable, sortable notes list with a single-click, single-window editor.
  • 🎨 Custom note titles and per-note background colors.
  • 📌 Pin notes to the top and ⭐ mark favorites.
  • ⚡ Keyboard shortcuts plus previous/next navigation.
  • 🗑️ Selective and bulk delete, always with confirmation.
  • 🔁 JSON & Markdown import/export with conflict handling.
  • 🌗 Light and dark theme support.
